name: Tandoori Chai Food Corner
description:
Tandoori Chai & Food Corner

Tandoori Chai & Food Corner is a dine-in and delivery restaurant serving a wide variety of delicious fast food, comfort food, and beverages at affordable prices. We are known for our flavorful recipes, generous portions, and quick service.

Our menu features an extensive range of sandwiches, pizzas, burgers, momos, pasta, fries, and starters, available in both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. We have something for every craving. We also serve popular snacks like Veg and Chicken Momos (steamed & fried), French Fries with multiple flavor, Garlic Bread, and Chicken Starters. Our burger section includes Veg, Cheese, Peri Peri, Chipotle, and Double Cheese Burgers, along with a full range of Chicken Burgers.

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent food and great service. The boti, khiri, seekh kabab, and tandoori chicken were absolutely amazing — full of flavor and perfectly cooked. A small place with delicious BBQ and Chinese food. Definitely a place worth visiting again.

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh Harisinghani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ever since our office shifted from Mahim to Santacruz, this street-side stall had been on my must-visit list and I’m glad I finally got to eat here!

The service is super quick and the kebabs are served piping hot, straight off the grill. We started with the chicken seekh kebab, which was soft, juicy, and perfectly tender—definitely a highlight.

The mutton seekh kebabs, were a bit of a letdown. The taste was just okay and lacked that meaty punch you’d expect.

The bheja masala was creamy, rich, and absolutely delicious. The kiri was another winner—buttery, indulgent and full of flavour.

Gravies and kebabs are served with pav, paratha or naan.
Great food at throwaway prices, which is exactly what you want from a street-side gem.

Will definitely be visiting again to try more items from the menu!

featured_reviews.name: Anish Karkera
featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nestled besides Yoko Sizzlers of Santacruz West area, Nice Fast Food is one of the places that will become you're instant favourite. If you're looking for a place in order to satisfy your kebabs craving then this is the place to be.

Coming to the order :

The SEEKH KEBAB was exceedingly moist, tender and flavourful. These melt-in-your-mouth kebabs will surely leave you begging for more.

Do yourself a favour and please try a plate of CHICKEN BAIDA ROTI which is so amazing that you might find yourself gulping it up all even before you realise.

If you like properly spiced and extremely generous portion of rice and soft chicken then the CHICKEN BIRYANI served here will keep you coming back for more.

CHICKEN RESHMI TIKKA was good in terms of texture and flavour combination.

CHICKEN KAATI ROLL was satisfactory.

So yes, drop by this humble eatery which is usually packed with family and friends happily tucking in as they offer tremendously delicious and mouth watering food.

featured_reviews.name: V2 IM
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent dining experience at this establishment was frustrating and disappointing. The staff exhibited an arrogant and dismissive attitude, refusing to communicate in Marathi despite operating in Maharashtra. It’s disheartening to see such behavior in a state that has historically welcomed and preserved cultural diversity.

Even more troubling was the apparent lack of respect for local pride and language, compounded by the intimidating environment created by certain local authorities and their support for such behavior. This left me feeling unwelcome in a space that should be inclusive and respectful.

The food itself was mediocre, with questionable hygiene standards. The high prices did not match the quality offered, raising concerns about whether the restaurant is adhering to fair pricing or regulatory standards.

Overall, the experience was far from satisfying. I hope the management takes serious steps to improve their service, respect the local culture, and offer an environment that feels safe and welcoming to all.
